svg.text: User sends an HTTP (port 80) request over the Internet.
Traffic enters the VPC through the Internet Gateway (IGW).
ALB (myalb1) listener on port 80 forwards to target group (myalbtgname).
Target group forwards to the Prod nodes (Docker app) in both AZs, port 5000.
Admin opens Jenkins UI (8080) or SSH (22) on Jenkins Master via the IGW.
Admin opens Grafana (3000) or Prometheus (9090) on the monitoring instance.
Jenkins Master connects over SSH (22) to Jenkins Node and both Prod nodes.
Prometheus scrapes node_exporter (:9100) on both Prod nodes (private IPs).
Jenkins Master reads Secrets Manager using its IAM role, via the IGW.
• ALB is deployed in both subnets (one node per AZ).
• Target group, attachments and app all use port 5000;
health check is HTTP / on the traffic port (5000).
• Prod nodes allow 5000 only from websg and 9100 only
from the monitoring SG. SSH (22) is open to 0.0.0.0/0.
• Monitoring SG opens Prometheus 9090, Grafana 3000 and
SSH 22 to 0.0.0.0/0. Prometheus has no login, so
restrict these to your own IP.
• Only Jenkins Master has the IAM instance profile.
• Both subnets are public (0.0.0.0/0 → IGW); no NAT
• Terraform state is stored in the S3 remote backend.
